head_mask_definition: Registered gaze_left source alpha>=128 inside HEAD (ears/tuft/eyes/nose/mouth/jaw/light fur); exclude only immutable-pose color changes>3 to keep the intended paw out. All candidate pixels are excluded from mask selection.
old_final_quiet_frames: Final8 frames are intentionally gaze_left for both versions; these are expected to match, not be rejected.
scope: All40 native action frames+2 each side, source-based actor consistency, independent changed-limb mask and static negative. Anatomical whole-head alpha and feet image stability measured separately. Head x/y3px negative controls guard against a common-mask false pass. Initial rectangular-head false alert remains in revision-details-001; this correction does not change media or thresholds. Not a claim of human real-time continuous viewing or that JSON pose names alone prove an action.
